2:128.text: Our Lord! And make us submissive unto You and of our offspring a nation submissive unto You, and show us our Manâsik
, and accept our repentance. Truly, You are the One Who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful.

2:129.text: Our Lord! Send amongst them a Messenger of their own
(and indeed Allâh answered their invocation by sending Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
, who shall recite unto them Your Verses and instruct them in the Book
(full knowledge of the Islâmic laws and jurisprudence or wisdom or Prophethood)
, and purify them. Verily! You are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise."

2:130.text: And who turns away from the religion of Ibrâhîm
except him who befools himself? Truly, We chose him in this world and verily, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.

2:131.text: When his Lord said to him, "Submit

2:132.text: upon his sons and by Ya‘qûb
, "O my sons! Allâh has chosen for you the
religion, then die not except in the Faith of Islâm

2:133.text: Or were you witnesses when death approached Ya‘qûb
? When he said unto his sons, "What will you worship after me?" They said, "We shall worship your Ilâh

2:134.text: That was a nation who has passed away. They shall receive the reward of what they earned and you of what you earn. And you will not be asked of what they used to do.
